DECISION: Ship a dark theme by default with an auto-switching contrast system based on ambient light and battery level, plus a persistent manual override toggle in the top-right corner.

Result: A theme that adapts to user conditions without forcing decisions, proven by override frequency and complaint rates. Owned by Facet.
